notes: Weekly nights from the store's per-game pages and homepage grid (checked 2026-10-10). Also comics, live DIY music, D&D, board games, Super Smash Bros. and fighting-game tournaments (not listed). Casual TCG play Sat and Sun 12-5 PM is free. Cyberpunk TCG is 'coming soon' (day/time TBD). Beyblade X tournaments ($8) run every other Sunday 1 PM but the anchor week is not published, so not listed (Wed 6 PM open play is). Riftbound (Tue 6:30 PM, $5 per the store) is not listed here: the store is not in the Riftbound importer's data. Conflicts in the store's own pages: the homepage HTML holds stale copies of the weekly grid (Pokemon Thu 7 PM; Riftbound Tue+Thu); the visible grid was used. The One Piece page also lists a Tue 6 PM $5 tournament that the grid omits.
